business_summary: BlueMeme Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the DX business in Japan. The company offers Outsystems, a low-code development platform, including rich grid component, SVF cloud connector, Omnext, and document generations services; MarkLogic, a multi-model database; Workato, an integration platform that automates various workflows that require collaboration between multiple applications with low code; Creatio, a no-code BPM platform for business applications that automates and visualizes business processes; and mabl, an AI-based test automation platform that enables low-code automatic testing of workflows, visuals, APIs, browser compatibility, and others. It also provides consulting services, including low-code implementation assessment services, business analysis and requirements definition services, remote technical support for business application development, and proposal for the development of AGILE-DX; contract development services, such as low-code contract development, source code migration services, and BlueMeme digital agent services; seminars and training of low code engineers; and sale and support of software products. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
